title: feat(plugin-email)!: email templates resolve from the registry; the built-in seed, the boot sweep and the live projector retire (ADR-0131 D6/D10, C4 stage 2)
body:
Fixes #15205
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

C4 stage 2, the registry loader half (ADR-0131 D6/D10, ruling C on §6 Q1, record 6020178017 on #22005). Claim 6109130514; dispatch from the `domain:services` seat 2. One cross-domain PR under triage's routing 6108741731 (the `packages/spec` ledger and describe text ride with the loader so `check:liveness` is never red on `main`).

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/plugin-email` reads templates from the registry.** `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader` (in `template-loader.ts`) resolves `email_template` by `(name, locale)` at every send through the protocol's layered execution list (`getMetaItemsForExecution` — the environment's item over each code package's declaration), or the ObjectQL registry on a host with no metadata door. The locale ladder is the row loader's, unchanged. Within one slot any other package's item, or a package-less environment item, wins over the built-in. A failed read propagates (never answered from the registry's package wording); a malformed item refuses the send with the schema's message instead of falling through to the built-in copy.
- **The built-in auth templates are code-declared items** of the email plugin's own package (`com.objectstack.service.email`), registered through its manifest at `init`. They now appear in Studio's email-template list; an app declaring the same `(name, locale)` wins; a Studio save overrides at environment level.
- **Retired:** `seedTemplates` (the boot seed), `bootstrap-declared-email-templates.ts` whole (`bootstrapDeclaredEmailTemplates`, `bootstrapEffectiveEmailTemplates`, `EffectiveEmailTemplateSources`, `upsertDeclaredEmailTemplate`, `deactivateDeclaredEmailTemplate`, `mapTemplateToRow`, `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_OBJECT`), the live projector (`wireTemplateMutationProjection`, `materializeTemplateMutation`, `readEffectiveTemplate`, the `metadata.subscribe` watcher), `createSysEmailTemplateLoader` and its two types, and the `seedTemplates` / `templates` plugin options. The changeset names each with its FROM → TO line.
- **Kept:** the `sys_email_template` object, its rows and the closed organization door (stage 1). No row is promoted or deleted: the customized rows are C7's (#15211). `TemplateLoader` / `EmailTemplateRow` stay as the service's render seam.
- **`packages/spec` (describe-only, no schema shape change):** the `email_template` liveness ledger is re-anchored by hand to the loader; the `IEmailService` contract docs, the notify node's `template` describe and refusal texts, and the `email-template.zod.ts` / `notification.zod.ts` prose name the registry, not rows. `gen:docs` regenerated two reference pages.
- **`service-automation`:** the notify node's `template` help text. **`platform-objects`:** the `sys_email_template` header comment and provenance comment (no field help changed, so no translation churn).

## Premise re-measured first (dispatch zone 2, items 1, 2, 4)

Scratch showcase measurement (never committed), `orgContext: true`, Default Organization bootstrapped, at `d8c7d3864`:

- A Studio `PUT /meta/email_template/showcase_task_done_email` lands **environment-scoped** (`sys_metadata.organization_id` null).
- Organization-free reads see it **live** (no restart) and **after a cold boot**: `SchemaRegistry.getItem`, `protocol.getMetaItem`, `protocol.getMetaItems` and `getMetaItemsForExecution` all serve the saved subject. `metadataService.get` / `list` answer nothing for the type.
- **Which read:** the layered execution list. `SchemaRegistry.listItems` hands back the environment item beside the package entry it overrides, both wearing the package's `_packageId` / `_provenance` (measured), and `getItem` answers one bundle member per name. The list has already decided precedence, one item per `(package, name, locale)` slot.
- **Live without a restart:** confirmed through the registry write-through; the projector had no job left and is gone (pinned: no projector, listener or subscription is armed; the `PUT` response carries no `projectionApplied`).

## Byte identity

`builtin-auth-render-identity.test.ts` renders all 24 built-in templates (6 names x 4 locales) through `EmailService.renderTemplate` and pins subject (clear) plus HTML and text (SHA-256). At `924da8d8a` it ran the seeded-row path (rows via `mapTemplateToRow`, the row loader) and the registry path side by side: identical for all 24. Since the row path's deletion it boots `EmailServicePlugin` over a real ObjectQL and holds the registry path to those digests.

## Pins rewritten, not deleted (dispatch zone 2, item 7)

- `bootstrap-declared-email-templates.test.ts` becomes `template-loader.test.ts`: every pin that asked whether the authored wording reaches the send is restated against the loader. Row-only mechanics (seed-not-clobber, provenance adoption, the bulk read) retired with the rows.
- `email-plugin.template-runtime-write.test.ts`: a save sends on the very next send; no seam armed; no `sys_email_template` read or write, pre-existing rows byte-unchanged; the `#16152` envelope pins moved to the loader path.
- `plugin-shutdown-detaches-template-bridge.test.ts`: shutdown releases the door (the only engine binding left).
- Dogfood: `email-template-overlay-survives-boot` (save environment-wide and live, survives a cold boot, a legacy customized row keeps its bytes and is not what sends, the closed data door), `email-template-materialization` (ADR-0054 proof keeps its `@proof` tag: no row, authored override beats the built-in, the built-in serves zh-CN, a Studio save over it sends without a restart), `email-template-boot-sweep` (real engine + SQL driver: zero statements reach the table on boot and send).
- `examples/app-showcase/test/email-template-locale.test.ts` runs through the registry loader (Q2 answer A).
- `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.test.ts`: the describe pin asserted `sys_email_template`; it now asserts the email templates and refuses the row wording.

## Ablations (each mutated, measured red, restored by blob equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`)

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, src-level at `fcd3b610a`: A1 a failed read falls back to the registry (2 red); A2 built-in precedence dropped (4 red); A3 malformed items skipped (3 red); A4 per-load read cached (6 red); A5 the plugin writes a row (1 red); A6 a projector armed (1 red); A7 the read names an organization (1 red). Dist leg: A5 rebuilt into `dist/` (`ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker), the dogfood statement pin went 2 red, then restore, rebuild, `--absent`, 2 green. A8: the notify describe back to `sys_email_template` reddens the flipped spec pin. A9: the re-pointed swallow-census resolution control reddens with departure ONE removed (its first attempt was a no-op the tool refused; re-run in delete mode).

- `plugin-email`: 33 files / 515 tests pass; typecheck OK. `spec`: 648 files / 19,375 tests pass; typecheck OK. `service-automation` notify-node 16/16 and typecheck OK; `platform-objects` typecheck OK.

- Narrowed lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 33 changed source files: 33 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored. The narrowing excludes nothing: `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Needs a decision: `email_template.category` and `.isSystem`

Their only consumer was the row projection this PR retires (a Setup column, and the built-in seeder's stand-down). Measured: no reader in this repository, and at the `.objectui-sha` pin `0df67f23` objectui reads both only as editor inputs. The ledger grades both `dead` (honest measurement; `label` and `description` stay `live` on the Studio list's default columns). Consequence: `packages/lint`'s `runtime-gate.inert-type-writes.test.ts` has 2 red cases, because a dead `category` now draws a `liveness-dead-property` advisory, and `category` is schema-defaulted (`'custom'`), so every template carries it and the advisory cannot be cleared by the author. Not resolved here: retiring the keys is a schema shape change this dispatch fences out, and `packages/lint` is outside the file surface. Options and the four-axis analysis are in the report comment on #15205.

## Acceptance notes

- Gate-forced edits outside the named surface, each the minimal answer to a gate naming retired code: `scripts/engine-double-contract.baseline.json` and `scripts/objectql-double-limit.baseline.json` (shrink-only rows for files now gone or clean), `scripts/isystem-census.mjs` (a `NON_ELEVATION_READS` row for the deleted module), `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` (a resolution control re-pointed by measurement: 21 departure-ONE sites remain, none write-shaped), the regenerated censuses (`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`, `tenant-audit-census.mdx` with its hand-written figures, `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`), and `packages/spec/liveness/README.md` plus the generated `state-counts/email_template.md`.
- Cross-lane docs edit, its own commit `94ab10722` (droppable): `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` described the materialization and seed-not-clobber this PR retires.
- Transitional, as ruled: a `sys_email_template` row an organization customized is no longer what sends until C7 promotes it. The changeset says so and names the re-save in Studio as the interim fix.
- Pre-existing defect observed (not this card's): `sys_metadata` holds one overlay row per `(type, name)`, so a Studio save of a second locale member of one `email_template` name replaces the first member's overlay at rest; live reads still show both until a restart, then the first reverts to package wording. Measured on the showcase; the row path showed the same revert at boot. Reported for filing.
- Comment-only references to retired names left outside the surface: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `registry-i18n-bundle-key.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/stack-email-template-locale-floor.test.ts`, `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/proof-registry.mts` (class prose), and the dogfood fixture `fixtures/email-template-materialization-fixture.ts` (header and manifest description).
- Changed lines: 4,490 (additions 1,517 + deletions 2,973, generated included). Over 3,000, so this lands the Tier H way. No governed surface in the file list.

## Patch round: the seat's answer B to Q1

The seat answered Q1 with B (`6111829211`): `email_template.category` and `.isSystem` land graded dead, and #22876 retires them in the next enforce-or-remove batch.

- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.inert-type-writes.test.ts`: the group-C case is split. `mapping` keeps its assertions and title. `email_template` now pins exactly one advisory, rule `liveness-dead-property` on property `category`. The shipped-corpus control pins the same single advisory; its `isSystem: false` draws nothing.
- `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`: a template that sets neither key still warns about nothing. `category`, and `isSystem: true`, each draw one dead-property advisory. The comments cite #22876.
- The tests assert the advisory's rule id and property path, not its wording. The lint rule, the ledger grading and the schema are untouched.
- Ablations L1 to L4 each went red (1 failed of 142) and were restored by blob.

The bare `no` was the seat's own error in the claim.

The BREAKING banner, the `minor` grade for `@objectstack/plugin-email`, the two `patch` rows and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` are unchanged. This body's second line carries the same arm.

## Seat's acceptance notes after the review

- **The `destroy()` drain-hook finding:** `EmailServicePlugin.destroy()` leaves the `sys_email` outbox drain hook bound on the engine after kernel shutdown. Carrier: none. It is noted here and not filed. Its only reach is an engine that outlives its kernel, measured on a test fake, which is below the filing gate's measured-reach bar. It is pre-existing and not this PR's. A semantic search for an open card on the class found none.
- **`check:platform-checklist` red on `main`:** the 8 findings are the known red that triage closed `not_planned` twice, #22594 and #22758 (`6093524974` sets the direction). Neither card's re-entry line is met. The gate is kept out of per-PR CI by standing decision (`.github/workflows/checklist-status.yml`). This seat files nothing.
- **For the maintainer, who approves this Tier H landing in any case:** ADR-0087's disposition vocabulary has no category that verifiably fits a compiler-carried removal of runtime exports in a diff that also touches `packages/spec`. This changeset and stage 1's (`15205-email-template-org-door-closed.md`) both hold `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on that reading. The open choice: rule that reading into the ADR's addendum, or add a seventh category. The at-tier review `6113872462` raised it, and it does not block this PR's substance.
